slug: 2026-01-28 The Gender Gap in Rural Niger State's Digital Identity

NGA.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
Only the female share of NIN holders is given, not a count or share of the population.
Nothing is stated on a number at birth.
Who operates the system is not stated beyond NIMC enrolment centres.

facts.fact: In 2025 the Niger State government launched an initiative integrating the NIN into the Social Safety Register, to improve identity verification for poor and vulnerable households.
NIMC reports enrolled NIN holders as of June 2025, with 21 NIN enrolment centres in Niger State, as TechCity NG reports.
